text:
BAB I

Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:

1. Kota adalah Kota Palembang.

3. W alikota adalah W alikota Palembang.

6. Unit Pelaksana Teknis Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat UPT PPA adalah Unit Pelaksana Teknis yang dibentuk pemerintah dalam memberikan pelayanan bagi perempuan dan anak yang mengalami kekerasan, diskriminasi, perlindungan khusus, dan masalah lainnya.
7. Perempuan adalah seluruh perempuan yang berada baik di dalam maupun luar rumah tangga.
8. Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 tahun termasuk anak yang masih dalam kandungan.
9. Tindak Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat a tau dapat mengakibatkan kesengsaraan atau penderitaan baik fisik, seksual, ekonomi, sosial, psikis terhadap korban.
10. Korban adalah perempuan dan/atau anak yang mengalami kesengsaraan dan/ atau penderitaan baik langsung maupun tidak langsung sebagai akibat dari tindak kekerasan.
11. Pelapor adalah orang, keluarga, dan masyarakat yang melihat, dan mendengar telah terjadi tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan atau setiap perempuan yang menjadi korban tindak kekerasan oleh orang lain.

translated_text:
CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. City is the City of Palembang.
2. City Government is the Government of the City of Palembang.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Palembang.
4. Regional Apparatus is the Regional Apparatus within the City Government.
5. Office of Women's Empowerment, Child Protection and Community Empowerment is the Office of Women's Empowerment, Child Protection and Community Empowerment of the City of Palembang.
6. Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as UPT PPA, is a Technical Implementation Unit established by the government to provide services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.
7. Women are all women who are both inside and outside the household.
8. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 years including a child who is still in the womb.
9. Act of Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, psychological to the victim.
10. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of an act of violence.
11. Reporter is a person, family, and community who sees and hears that an act of violence has occurred against a woman or any woman who becomes a victim of an act of violence by another person.
12. Protection of Women and Children in Conflict with the Law is a form of service that must be carried out by law enforcement officers or security officers to provide a sense of security, both physical and psychological to victims or witnesses from threats, disturbances, terror, and violence from any party given at the stage of investigation, inquiry, prosecution and examination at trial.
13. Protection .....

.. ., - 5 -

27. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife or husband, wife and their children, or father and their children, or mother and their children or blood relatives in a straight line upwards or downwards up to the third degree.
28. Family Resilience is the dynamic condition of a family that has tenacity and toughness and contains physical material and spiritual mental abilities to live independently and develop themselves and their families to live harmoniously in improving physical and spiritual welfare.
29. Community is a group of citizens who inhabit an administrative area of government (at the level of Neighborhood Association, Community Association, Village and Sub-district) that is official and cooperates in life for a sufficiently long time and obeys existing rules.
30. Religious Leaders consist of Ustadz/Ustadzah, Ulama, Pastors, Priests, Monks, Pedanda/Pandita/Sulinggih and other religious leaders who have gender sensitivity/awareness.
31. Companion is a person or representative of an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy in order to provide strengthening and recovery of victims of violence as stipulated in a decision of an authorized official.

translated_text:
Article 3

The regulation of protection of women and children from acts of violence aims to:
a. prevent violence against women and childrenb. protect, provide a sense of security for women and children;c. provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; andd. empower women victims of violence.

heading: CHAPTER II
Article 6
text:
Pasal 6

1. Bentuk tindak kekerasan fisik sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf a bahwa kekerasan fisik adalah setiap perbuatan yang mengakibatkan rasa sakit menurut ahli medis, ceder�, Iuka atau cacat pada tubuh seseorang, gugurnya kandungan, p1ngsan dan/ atau menyebabkan kematian.
2. Bentuk tindak kekerasan psikis sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf b bahwa kekerasan psikis adalah perbuatan yang mengakibatkan ketakutan, hilangnya rasa percaya diri, hilangnya kemampuan untuk bertindak, rasa tidak berdaya dan/ atau penderitaan psikis berat pada seseorang.
3. Bentuk tindak kekerasan seksual sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf c bahwa kekerasan seksual adalah setiap perbuatan yang berupa pelecehan seksual, pemaksaan hubungan seksual, dengan secara tidak wajar atau tidak disukai oleh salah satu pihak untuk tujuan komersil dan atau tujuan tertentu.
4. Bentuk penelantaran sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf d bahwa penelantaran adalah perbuatan melepaskan dan atau meninggalkan tanggung jawab perhatian, pengasuhan, pendidikan dan nafkah terhadap setiap orang yang menjadi anggota keluarga.
5. Bentuk eksploitasi sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf e bahwa eksploitasi adalah memanfaatkan segala bentuk potensi baik fisik, psikis dan kecerdasan pada perempuan atau anak untuk keuntungan ekonomi maupun kesenangan pribadi pelaku.
translated_text:
Article 6

1. The form of physical violence as referred to in Article 5 letter a is that physical violence is any act that results in pain according to medical experts, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and/or causing death.
2. The form of psychological violence as referred to in Article 5 letter b is that psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering to a person.
3. The form of sexual violence as referred to in Article 5 letter c is that sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, in an unnatural manner or not desired by one party for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
4. The form of neglect as referred to in Article 5 letter d is that neglect is the act of releasing and or abandoning the responsibility of attention, care, education and livelihood towards every person who is a family member.
5. The form of exploitation as referred to in Article 5 letter e is that exploitation is utilizing all forms of potential both physical, psychological and intelligence in women or children for economic gain or personal pleasure of the perpetrator.

Article 9

1. Participate in prevention and provide support for the development of prevention programs against violations of the rights of women and children from acts of violence.
2. Provide information and/or report violations of the rights of women and children from acts of violence to the competent authorities.
3. Monitor the law enforcement process regarding cases of violations of the rights of women and children from acts of violence.

heading: Article 10
text:
Pasal 10

Keluarga dalam upaya perlindungan terhadap hak perempuan dan  anak bertanggung jawab:
a. melindungi perempuan dan anak dari konflik dan kekerasan dalam rumah tangga yang merendahkan martabat perempuan dan anak;
b. memberikan kesempatan yang sama pada perempuan dan anak mengembangkan diri di bidang pendidikan, sosial, ekonomi, politik dan budaya; danc. mencegah terjadinya pelanggaran terhadap hak perempuan dan anak dalam rumah tangga.
translated_text:
Article 10

The family in efforts to protect the rights of women and children is responsible for:
a. protecting women and children from conflict and violence in the household that degrades the dignity of women and children;
b. providing equal opportunities for women and children to develop themselves in the fields of education, social, economic, political and cultural affairs; andc. preventing violations of the rights of women and children in the household.

heading: Article 15
Article 16
text:
Pasal 16

1. Pengaduan tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak dapat dilakukan oleh pelapor yang terdiri atas korban, keluarga, masyarakat dan/ atau organisasi kemasyarakatan.
2. Pelapor sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat dilakukan dengan pengaduan:a. secara langsung atau temuan langsung;
b. melalui telpon atau sejenisnya; danc. melalui surat.
3. Selain penanganan pengaduan yang disampaikan oleh pelapor, petugas pada lembaga pelayanan juga berwenang melakukan penanganan perempuan dan anak korban dari tindak kekerasan yang diperoleh melalui informasi lainnya.
4. Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai tata cara pelayanan penanganan pengaduan diatur dengan Peraturan Walikota.
translated_text:
Article 16

1. Complaints of acts of violence against women and children may be made by reporters consisting of victims, families, the community and/ or community organizations.
2. Reporters as referred to in paragraph (1) may be made through complaints:a. directly or direct findings;
b. by telephone or the like; andc. by letter.
3. In addition to handling complaints submitted by reporters, officers at service institutions are also authorized to handle women and children victims of acts of violence obtained through other information.
4. Further provisions regarding the procedures for handling complaint services are regulated by Mayor Regulation.
